✦ About Us

About The New Royal Sapha

We specialize in Royal Safa Services for Weddings, Tilak Ceremonies, Engagements and Baraat Events. Our master artisans combine centuries-old Rajasthani traditions with modern styling — creating a truly royal experience for every groom.

Our team travels to your venue and hand-ties every safa with precision, using premium fabrics and adorned with authentic Kalgi, Brooch and decorative elements. Serving Rewa and the surrounding 50km region with pride.

✦ FAQs

Common Questions

Hum suggest karte hain ki booking kam se kam 15–30 din pehle karein, especially peak wedding season (November–February) mein. Urgent bookings ke liye WhatsApp karein — hum 7 din tak possible hai.
Booking confirm karne ke liye 30% advance payment liya jata hai. Baki 70% payment event ke din service complete hone ke baad diya ja sakta hai. UPI, cash, aur bank transfer — sabhi acceptable hain.
Event se 15 din pehle cancellation par full advance refund milta hai. 7–14 din pehle 50% refund. 7 din se kam mein cancellation par advance refund nahi hoga, lekin doosri date par reschedule possible hai.
Haan, bilkul! Humari team directly aapke event venue par aati hai. Hum Rewa aur 500km aas-paas ke area mein travel karte hain. Travel charges alag se applicable ho sakte hain.
